app.name: Sacred Pair
app.tagline: Bringing people together, one individual at a time.

landing.title: Find a life partner, then grow together.
landing.body: Sacred Pair is for people who are serious about a lasting relationship. Each week you see four thoughtfully chosen profiles. When you both choose each other, you start a journey together.
landing.accountDeleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for being part of Sacred Pair.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.intro: Everyone on Sacred Pair verifies a government ID, so you always know you're meeting real people.
verify.how: Take a photo of your ID or upload one, then take a quick selfie so we can match it to your ID photo. It takes about two minutes.
verify.privacy: Our verification partner, Stripe, checks your ID. Sacred Pair keeps only the result and your date of birth, never a copy of your ID.

reasons.document_expired: That ID has expired. Use one that's still valid.
reasons.document_type_not_supported: That type of ID isn't accepted. Use a driver's license, passport or state ID.
reasons.selfie_face_mismatch: Your selfie didn't match the photo on your ID. Try again in good light, facing the camera.
reasons.selfie_unusable: We couldn't use your selfie. Try again in good light with your whole face in view.
reasons.abandoned: Verification stopped before it was finished.
reasons.birthdate_unreadable: We couldn't read the date of birth on your ID. Use a clear photo with all four corners in view.
reasons.unreadable: We couldn't read your ID. Use a clear photo in good light with all four corners in view.

verify.processingBody: This usually takes less than a minute. You can stay on this page; it moves on by itself.
verify.verifiedBody: Thanks for helping keep Sacred Pair a place for real people.

blockers.underage: Sacred Pair is only for adults 18 and older. Your ID shows you're under 18, so this account can't be verified.
blockers.too_many_attempts: You've started verification five times today. Try again tomorrow.

simulate.title: Test verification
simulate.banner: Test mode. No ID is checked here. This page only exists on development copies of Sacred Pair, so you can try every outcome without Stripe.

chat.title: Chat with your connections

home.heroNote: Every member verifies their ID. Free to join.

verified.title: Verified adults only

private.body: Only the people you're introduced to can see your profile. Your location, email and phone are never shown.

noStrangers.title: No messages from strangers
